pkgmetadata.longdescription: Concat (formerly WolfCut) is a free, open-source CapCut-style video editor: multi-track timelines, split/trim/merge, transitions, speed control, auto-captions, voice filters, and text overlays. It is a Slint application whose Rust engine links FFmpeg libraries directly. This package installs the upstream prebuilt amd64 deb payload; it does not build the app from source. Transcription and text-to-speech run through the compiled-in whisper.cpp and a statically linked sherpa-onnx runtime, with models downloaded on demand at first use.

use.flag: Replace bundled FFmpeg libraries with the matching FFmpeg 8.1 ABI from media-video/ffmpeg.
